description: E28保存模型/输入与成熟标签更新解释的登记，冻结原67机会和两模型全部评分。
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib
ROOT=Path.cwd();R='reports/research/510300_saved_export_information_update_v1';OUT=ROOT/R
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def readj(p):return json.loads((ROOT/p).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
assert not OUT.exists();OUT.mkdir(parents=True)
proposal=readj('reports/research/510300_export_score_target_gap_diagnostic_v1/next_experiment.json')
assert proposal['experiment_id']=='E28'
paths=[x['path'] for x in proposal['preliminary_references']]
paths+=['reports/research/510300_export_score_target_gap_diagnostic_v1/next_experiment.json',
 'reports/research/510300_export_score_target_gap_diagnostic_v1/本轮目标接续归属.json',
 'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/protocol.json',
 'reports/research/510300_saved_high_score_leaf_contribution_v1/全部70事件保存叶分布.csv',
 'reports/research/510300_saved_high_score_leaf_contribution_v1/全部原叶训练成员.csv']
parents=[{'path':p,'bytes':(ROOT/p).stat().st_size,'sha256':sha(ROOT/p)} for p in paths]
for x in proposal['preliminary_references']:
    assert sha(ROOT/x['path'])==x['sha256'],'提案后原输入变化：'+x['path']
p={'study_id':'510300_SAVED_EXPORT_INFORMATION_UPDATE_V1','experiment_id':'E28','registered_at':now(),
 'previous_goal_turn_classification':'PROGRESS_E25_PRIOR_USE_CLOSED_E26_FIXED_COMPARE_AND_E27_TARGET_GAP_COMPLETED',
 'status':'REGISTERED_SAVED_INPUT_MODEL_AND_MATURE_LABEL_UPDATE_EXPLANATION',
 'question':proposal['question'],'hypotheses':proposal['hypotheses'],
 'scope':{'models':['外需十变量','原纠错八变量'],'dates_per_model':1212,'adjacent_saved_pairs_per_model':1211,
 'natural_events':{'外需十变量':32,'原纠错八变量':35},'natural_population':'全部固定80分/正预测自然不重叠事件，原主/早期不变，不筛赢家'},
 'source_clock':'原输入中的出口来源可知时间、出口统计月、数值与原订单时钟；新原文与数值更新分别记录。训练退出边界不晚于原决策日。',
 'four_cells':proposal['four_cells'],
 'formula':{'input_at_old_model':'B-A','model_at_old_input':'C-A','nonlinear_interaction':'D-B-C+A','total':'D-A'},
 'score_function':'每棵保存树的叶均值及叶成员数还原原训练预测百分位；分数改变还包含原训练分布更新，不是上涨概率。',
 'comparison_tolerance':'保存预测/原叶均值/分数和算术恒等式绝对误差1e-12；只判数值变化，不是交易阈值。',
 'float32_rule':'输入按原sklearn float32分支比较，保留保存阈值/均值/样本数。',
 'mature_pool':'原共同成熟训练池逐日training_indices直接复用；不增删、重权或产生新标签。',
 'leaf_flow':'原当前输入下新/旧树实际叶成员；模型在当前输入的均值差分为新成熟、滚出、保留成员分组/均值权重变化的算术贡献，成员变化不是已识别重训练因果。',
 'existing_control_leaf_reuse':'原35控制事件实际叶成员用E23八变量成员表复用，并核对原保存树/均值；不重做其已完成月份结论。',
 'interpretation_limits':[proposal['four_cell_limits'],
  '当前树(旧输入)事后才存在，不能回填原旧决策。',
  '没有重新拟合删除新增标签的树，因此成员算术贡献不能单独证明该标签导致某次树结构变化。',
  '政策窗口与标签重合不等于政策收益因果份额；历史首版/最早公开仍未认证。',
  '已见历史不是独立验证，不恢复E26失败、不把四格变成新的交易规则。'],
 'parents':parents,'new_source_requests':0,'new_fits':0,'new_training_labels':0,'new_full_accounts':0,
 'source_code_edits':0,'parameter_grids':0,'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,
 'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','orders_authorized':False,'goal_achieved':False}
(OUT/'protocol.json').write_text(json.dumps(p,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'E28':'已登记保存模型解释','父文件':len(parents),'原日期每模型':1212,'原机会':67,'新拟合':0,'新账户':0},ensure_ascii=False))
